  - Configuration settings for two file systems in the test setup were updated to set the default file system name to `VIEWFS_URI`. This ensures that the test environment is correctly configured to test the changes made in the `DistributedFileSystem`.

#### 2. Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `DistributedFileSystem.java` establish a new approach to handling rename operations, specifically removing the previous checks for path ownership relative to the file system. This change directly affects how the `FileSystemLinkResolver.java` operates, as it now assumes paths belong to the same file system without needing to verify. 

The updates in the test file `TestViewFileSystemHdfs.java` are related to ensuring that the testing environment reflects these changes, confirming that the new behavior of the `rename` functionality operates correctly under the assumption that paths belong to the appropriate file system.
